primary.prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup.
Create a high-fidelity mobile UI redesign presentation for the EXISTING Japanese news reading and EPUB library app named exactly "富士見新聞文庫". This is a design proposal, not a screenshot of a running app. Show THREE complete, large, perfectly frontal mobile UI screens side by side on one presentation board: daily news, article reading, bookshelf. Make the result convincingly designed by a top Japanese product design studio: contemporary, clear, functional, beautiful and designed for long reading on a 390px-wide phone.

COMPOSITION: landscape board at the highest available resolution, approximately 2400 x 1600, neutral very light blue-gray #EEF1F7 backdrop. Small refined board title "富士見新聞文庫" and subtitle "手机端界面设计 · 日刊 / 阅读 / 书架" at top left. Three equal 390:844 viewport proportions, evenly aligned, generous margins. Flat screen artboards with 26px rounded outer corners, tiny subtle shadows, NO physical device hardware, NO tilted perspective, NO decorative props. UI fills the screen artboards. Minimal top status bars with time 9:41. Under screens simple small Chinese captions "日刊", "沉浸阅读", "书架". Maximize screenshot size and readable UI, not exterior branding.

DESIGN SYSTEM: surface white #FFFFFF; canvas #F5F7FC; almost-black navy text #17233E; muted readable text #67738B; primary indigo #4055B5; subtle selected-state blue #E8EDFF. Small restrained lavender #CBC9EB only within book artwork, not general UI decoration. The app should feel fresh, calm, precise and modern Japanese, with strong typographic hierarchy and generous intentional spacing. Distinctive memorable typographic news headlines, excellent content photography. UI font Japanese Noto Sans JP / Hiragino Kaku Gothic; article body a refined highly readable Japanese serif like Noto Serif JP. Titles 26–30px phone scale; news headlines 21–23px; article body 17–18px; secondary 12–14px. Body black against white. Screen inner margins 22–24px. 8px spacing rhythm, 48px touch controls. Images 16px radius; grouped functional controls 12px radius. Most content is open on the white page, NOT an endless grid of identical elevated cards. Fine quiet separators. Consistent thin-line icons. No warm beige, no moss green, no vermilion, no gradients, no glassmorphism, no giant English slogans, no 01/02 decorative labels.

NAVIGATION: all THREE screens show the exact same full-width bottom navigation with FIVE icons plus labels "日刊", "閲読室", "書架", "辞書", "設置". Proper spacious safe area below. Active destination uses an indigo icon and small soft-indigo background behind the icon, with clear darker label. The first screen selects 日刊; middle selects 閲読室; third selects 書架. Keep all content and mini player ABOVE navigation; no overlaps. Bookmark collection accessible through a single outline bookmark icon in the top app bar, NOT a sixth bottom tab. Top branding small and balanced, no oversized corporate masthead.

SCREEN 1 DAILY:
Compact top row of the brand "富士見新聞文庫" with a tiny simple indigo open-book mark and an outline bookmark button at right.
Heading "本日ノニュース" with a small date control "11月2日 月曜日" and calendar icon underneath. Quiet summary "今日の9篇".
Below, one excellent atmospheric lead news photo: Japanese temple and hillside crimson autumn leaves, realistic editorial photograph, blue clear sky, ratio around 16:9 and rounded corners. Below photo a small clear "NHKニュース" source and "09:20", then strong 2-line headline exactly "秋深まる京都、\n紅葉が見頃に". One restrained readable 2-line Japanese excerpt.
Then two compact news rows separated by subtle rules, each left bold Japanese title and source, right a 76px rounded thumbnail: a modern Japanese rail platform, then a scientific observatory. Headlines "地域をつなぐ、新しい鉄道のかたち" and "宇宙の始まりに迫る新たな観測". Good white space. Bottom navigation clearly visible.
All content is fictional example content; do not portray as live news.

SCREEN 2 ARTICLE READING:
Compact header with back chevron, small "閲読室" label, right bookmark and more icons. Small source "NHKニュース" and date "11月2日".
Large beautifully typeset 3-line Japanese title "秋深まる京都、\n紅葉が見頃に".
A compact rounded segmented toolbar "原文" (selected), "译文", "假名", with a separate small dictionary icon. Do not add font-size, line-height, vertical-writing or search controls.
Article body as real Japanese serif text with elegant long-reading spacing: "京都市内では、朝晩の冷え込みが続き、木々の葉が鮮やかに色づいています。" and "寺の境内には、秋の景色を楽しもうと多くの人が訪れています。"
Show subtle accurate ruby over only a few kanji in the first paragraph, not over every single character.
Show one compact Chinese translation directly under the first Japanese paragraph in a very pale blue inset with a small label "译文": "京都市内早晚持续降温，树叶逐渐染上鲜艳的秋色。" This demonstrates bilingual reading.
Second Japanese paragraph below and a restrained current-paragraph pale blue highlight.
Above bottom navigation a neat real-looking compact audio control bar with label "即时朗读", an indigo play button, small previous/next paragraph icons and a slim playback line. No fake waveform, no artificial AI status, no saved-audio claim.

SCREEN 3 BOOKSHELF:
Same compact brand header and bookmark icon. Large title "書架" and subtle count "12 冊". Small header more button for existing library controls. Do not show a mobile EPUB import action because native import is not universally available.
A horizontal continue-reading feature inside a soft #E8EDFF container: a small tasteful illustrated Japanese novel cover at left, label "読みかけ", title "銀河鉄道の夜", author "宮沢賢治", chapter "午後の授業", thin progress bar with "36%", action "続きを読む" with small chevron. Container height around 180px phone scale, no oversized heavy color area.
Below, section heading "本棚" and sort label "最近読んだ順".
Two columns of beautifully designed, believable full-color Japanese book covers: "銀河鉄道の夜" with moonlit indigo train-window artwork; "こころ" with delicate muted red Japanese graphic print; bottom row partially visible "雪国" and "羅生門". Each has title and muted author BELOW its cover. Book covers should feel like physical printed Japanese literature, sophisticated artwork, no fake product ratings, no store prices, no purchase buttons. Covers proportional ~2:3. Enough book content visible to feel useful.
Bottom navigation consistent.

TEXT AND QUALITY: Render Japanese and Chinese CJK text cleanly and accurately; use the supplied strings verbatim, no gibberish, no Latin lorem ipsum. All small text should look intentionally laid out. Touch controls have breathing space. No content clipped at screen edges or under fixed bars. No feature advertisements, no gamification, notifications, subscriptions, streaks, accounts, or invented social controls. The final image must be a polished, realistic, implementable app UI design proposal, not abstract concept art.

support.prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup.
Create a SECOND high-fidelity mobile UI design board for "富士見新聞文庫", continuing the exact visual design system of the reference image. Reference image 1 is a STYLE AND COMPONENT REFERENCE, NOT an edit target: keep its white surfaces, indigo accents, typography, icon style, artboard proportions, spacing and five-item bottom navigation. Generate a NEW board of THREE large complete mobile screens: dictionary, settings overview, voice selector bottom sheet. Do not reproduce the three screens from the reference.

COMPOSITION: highest available quality landscape board, approximately 2400 x 1600, light blue-gray #EEF1F7 background, three equal frontal 390:844 mobile artboards, 26px rounded corners and tiny soft shadows. No device hardware or perspective. Small top-left title "富士見新聞文庫", subtitle "手机端界面设计 · 辞书 / 设置 / 声线". Bottom captions "辞书", "设置", "声线选择". Screens should occupy most of the board. All artboards fully visible and aligned.

DESIGN SYSTEM locked to reference: white #FFFFFF, pale gray-blue #F5F7FC, dark navy text #17233E, readable muted #67738B, indigo #4055B5, soft selected blue #E8EDFF. Japanese UI font Noto Sans JP/Hiragino, thoughtful weight hierarchy, 22–24px side padding, 8px spacing rhythm, comfortable controls. Strong readable type, no excess chrome, realistic production UI. Main titles 28px. Content 16px, secondary 12–14px. Group related settings rows, not a separate card for each row. Use consistent small fine-line icons, gently rounded search/input fields. No beige/green/red theme, no gradients, no glassmorphism.

BOTTOM NAV: exactly FIVE icon+label destinations in the same positions as the reference: "日刊", "閲読室", "書架", "辞書", "設置". First artboard 辞書 selected, second artboard 設置 selected. Active icon indigo with subtle blue rounded indicator, inactive navy-gray. Correct bottom safe area and no overlap. Brand top app bar "富士見新聞文庫" with tiny outline open-book mark at left and outline bookmark button at right. 9:41 status bars.

SCREEN 1 DICTIONARY:
Top brand row; large heading "辞書" with small count "159,396 語". A clear 50px tall search field with magnifier, actual input value "余白", and x clear icon. Below a neat subtle result summary "1 件の結果".
Show an expanded dictionary entry using beautiful Japanese typography, large word "余白" about 38px, reading "よはく" just below, small outlined audio speaker button to right. Small part-of-speech pill "名詞".
Definition heading "释义" followed by numbered senses with readable Chinese text:
"① 空白；余白。"
"纸张、书页上没有文字或图画的部分。"
Japanese usage block with a pale blue very restrained background: label "用例", sentence "ページの余白にメモを書く。", below Chinese "在书页的空白处做笔记。". A small indigo speaker button aligned with Japanese sentence, generous line spacing.
Then a quieter "関連語" section with compact text entries "空白　空欄".
Near lower portion a section "最近查过" with small history chips "木漏れ日", "物語", "静か". These are history, not recommendations. Real dictionary functionality only; no flashcards, saved word buttons, quizzes, vocabulary streaks or invented features. Clear generous white space, elegant and useful.

SCREEN 2 SETTINGS:
Top brand row, large heading exactly "設置" and single small subtitle "読む時間を、自分らしく。".
Near top a distinctive shallow pale indigo feature row for current voice: outline speaker icon, label "声の形", selected value "系统日语声线", right chevron. Smaller explanation "文章・書籍・辞書の即时朗读".
Then compact section caption "日刊" above one white grouped settings block with hairline separators and three comfortable rows: "每日篇数" value "10 篇" with chevron; "新闻来源" value "6 个来源" with chevron; "更新方式" value "毎日 00:00" with chevron. Optional small quiet "今すぐ生成" text action at lower right of this group, not a huge full-width CTA.
Next compact heading "阅读与文庫", grouped rows "書架表示" value "最近読んだ順" and "文庫刷新" right chevron.
Next heading "本机与同步", grouped rows "翻译密钥" value "未配置" and "Windows 同步" value "未连接". Neutral status text, no green success claims, no API key visible, no local file paths shown.
All rows look tappable, 48–52px tall, calm roomy layout with enough visible content. App information can be a small bottom row "应用信息" with chevron if space, otherwise omit. Do not add account, notification, theme, font, subscription, login or AI chatbot settings. Bottom nav fully visible.

SCREEN 3 VOICE SELECTOR SHEET:
Same settings screen as screen 2 behind a dark translucent scrim. A beautifully designed white bottom sheet comes up from the bottom, with 24px top corners, a small centered drag indicator and a clearly accessible x close button at upper right. Sheet covers ~76% of screen height, above the darkened settings header. The underlying navigation is obscured by the sheet, not duplicated in the sheet.
Title "声の形" and explanation "选择文章、书籍与词典的即时朗读声线。".
List starts section "当前设备". Row "系统日语声线", subtitle "日本語 · 当前设备", an indigo filled radio indicating selected, subtle blue highlight behind row.
Then section "本地模型". Four rows with empty outlined radio circles, each correct Japanese name:
"アルファ" subtitle "Kokoro · 需要本地模型"
"春日部つむぎ" subtitle "VOICEVOX · 需要本地模型"
"東北イタコ" subtitle "VOICEVOX · 需要本地模型"
"東北ずん子" subtitle "VOICEVOX · 需要本地模型".
A fifth partially visible row "九州そら" suggests a scrollable list. All rows spaced evenly, 62px tall, quiet separators. Do not claim local models are installed or playable on Android.
In a stationary sheet footer above the safe area one full-width indigo button with white speaker icon and text "试听当前声线". This uses the actual selected system voice; no fake waveform, no unimplemented synthesized-audio promises. Neutral helper line "本地模型的可用性取决于当前运行环境。" in 12px muted readable text.

All text should be clear accurate Japanese and simplified Chinese. No English lorem ipsum. Do not invent features outside the specified existing application. Design must feel coherent with the reference board, highly polished and practical for a real 390px phone.
